title: BB-13: Staff records blood units with calculated expiry dates
body:
## User story
As an authorized staff member, I want to record blood units and have expiry dates calculated so that usable inventory has accurate identification and dates.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-006; FR-007; SEC-002; SEC-003.

## Planning
- Owner: Inventory/expiry owner
- Sprint: 3 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: Approved component shelf-life and quantity rules; role access; inventory schema

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Staff can record a unit with blood group, component type, collection date and quantity.
- [ ] Each unit has a unique identifier and invalid or duplicate unit identifiers are rejected.
- [ ] Only supported component types and valid field values are accepted.
- [ ] Expiry is calculated from collection date using approved component-specific shelf-life rules.
- [ ] Collection-date and expiry-boundary fixtures produce the expected dates.
- [ ] Unauthorized users cannot create or alter inventory records.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, unit-recording/validation and shelf-life calculation tests, and a blood-unit entry demo.

title: BB-14: Staff sees current component-wise blood stock
body:
## User story
As an authorized staff member, I want current stock counts by blood group and component so that I can understand available inventory.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-008; NFR-001; SEC-002.

## Planning
- Owner: Inventory/expiry owner
- Sprint: 3 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-13; approved stock-inclusion/status rules; issue updates integrated later

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The stock view shows counts/quantities by blood group and component using approved stock-inclusion rules.
- [ ] Counts reconcile with underlying unit records and status fixtures.
- [ ] Recorded changes refresh the view according to the agreed real-time behavior.
- [ ] Issued, expired, discarded or quarantined stock is handled according to approved availability rules.
- [ ] Unauthorized users cannot access restricted stock-management actions.
- [ ] 95% of inventory API requests receive a response within 2 seconds under the approved test load.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, stock reconciliation/integration tests, inventory load-test results and a stock-view demo.

title: BB-15: Staff receives near-expiry and low-stock alerts
body:
## User story
As an authorized staff member, I want alerts for near-expiry units and low stock so that I can take timely inventory action.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-009; FR-010; SEC-002.

## Planning
- Owner: Inventory/expiry owner, with notification support
- Sprint: 3 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-13, BB-14; approved threshold, expiry/timezone and mocked notification policies

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Units within the configured near-expiry threshold are flagged.
- [ ] Staff receive the agreed mocked notification for a near-expiry condition.
- [ ] Available stock below the configured blood-group/component minimum generates a low-stock alert.
- [ ] Threshold boundary fixtures distinguish alert and non-alert conditions correctly.
- [ ] Threshold configuration follows the approved authorized mechanism.
- [ ] Notification attempts, successful mocked receipt and failures are recorded without sensitive data exposure.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, threshold/date-boundary tests, mocked notification receipt/failure evidence and an alert demo.

title: BB-16: Staff safely issues matching blood against an approved request
body:
## User story
As an authorized staff member, I want to issue matching usable blood against an approved request so that the request is fulfilled without unsafe selection or double issue.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-011; FR-015; FR-016; NFR-004; SEC-002; DATA-01.

## Planning
- Owner: Request/issue owner, with inventory support
- Sprint: 4 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-13, BB-14, BB-17, BB-18; approved quantity and fulfilment semantics; chosen database

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An issue record can be created only for an approved request and a matching non-expired unit.
- [ ] Expired, discarded or quarantined units cannot be selected or issued through either UI or API.
- [ ] A successful issue decrements the corresponding stock exactly once.
- [ ] Issue record creation and stock updates succeed or fail together in one transaction.
- [ ] Concurrent attempts cannot issue the same unit against two different approved requests.
- [ ] Concurrency tests use the chosen real database with separate connections.
- [ ] Failed issue attempts leave inventory and request state consistent.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, transactional/negative tests, real-database concurrency evidence, stock reconciliation and an issue demo.

title: BB-17: Hospital or requester submits a blood request
body:
## User story
As a hospital/requester user, I want to submit a request specifying blood group, component, quantity and urgency so that staff can review my blood requirement.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-012; SEC-002; SEC-003.

## Planning
- Owner: Request/issue owner
- Sprint: 4 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-01, BB-04; approved requester provisioning and quantity rules

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An authorized requester can submit the required request fields through the interface.
- [ ] A valid request is saved with SUBMITTED status.
- [ ] Missing fields, unsupported values and invalid quantities are rejected with clear feedback.
- [ ] The saved request is associated with the authenticated requester.
- [ ] The requester receives confirmation and can identify the submitted request.
- [ ] Unauthenticated or unauthorized submissions are rejected.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, request submission/validation/ownership tests and a request-creation demo.

title: BB-18: Staff reviews blood requests in urgency order
body:
## User story
As an authorized staff member, I want to review pending requests in urgency order and approve or reject them so that blood requests receive controlled decisions.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-013; FR-014; SEC-002.

## Planning
- Owner: Request/issue owner
- Sprint: 4 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-17; approved urgency ordering and request-state transitions

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Newly submitted requests appear in the staff review queue.
- [ ] Pending requests are ordered by the approved urgency ordering and tie-break policy.
- [ ] Staff can approve or reject a request only from permitted states.
- [ ] Rejection requires a reason that is saved with the decision.
- [ ] Approval/rejection updates request status consistently.
- [ ] Unauthorized users cannot review or change the decision through UI or API.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, urgency-ordering/state-transition/rejection-reason tests and a staff-review demo.

title: BB-19: Requester tracks the status of their blood request
body:
## User story
As a hospital/requester user, I want to view my request status so that I know whether it has been submitted, reviewed, issued or closed.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-017; SEC-002.

## Planning
- Owner: Request/issue owner
- Sprint: 4 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-17, BB-18, BB-16; approved closure and partial-fulfilment semantics

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The requester can view the current status of their own requests.
- [ ] SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED, ISSUED and CLOSED are displayed when applicable under the approved lifecycle.
- [ ] Review and issue actions are reflected consistently in the requester view.
- [ ] A rejection reason is displayed where permitted by the approved policy.
- [ ] Partial fulfilment and CLOSED transitions follow approved definitions rather than guessed behavior.
- [ ] A requester cannot access another requester's restricted request records.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, lifecycle/status/ownership tests and an end-to-end request-status demo.

title: BB-20: Authorized organizers manage donation camps
body:
## User story
As an authorized camp organizer, I want to create, update and cancel donation camps so that donation events have accurate dates, locations and capacity.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-021; SEC-002; SEC-003.

## Planning
- Owner: Scheduling/notification/reporting owner
- Sprint: 5 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: Approved camp action-by-role matrix; camp schema

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] An actor authorized for the specific action can create a camp with date, location and capacity.
- [ ] Authorized updates persist valid changed details.
- [ ] Cancellation follows an approved policy for existing bookings and donor communication.
- [ ] Invalid dates, missing locations and invalid capacity values are rejected.
- [ ] Unauthorized create/update/cancel attempts are rejected by the server.
- [ ] The SRS conflict between staff/admin camp management and admin-only create/cancel is resolved before the affected acceptance tests are finalized.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, approved camp permission/cancellation policy, CRUD/validation/access tests and a camp-management demo.

title: BB-21: Donor books an available donation appointment without overbooking
body:
## User story
As a donor, I want to book an available camp or walk-in donation slot so that I have a confirmed appointment without exceeding slot capacity.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-018; FR-019; SEC-002.

## Planning
- Owner: Scheduling/notification/reporting owner
- Sprint: 5 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-20; approved walk-in slot model, capacity rules and chosen database

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The donor can select and book an available camp or walk-in slot supported by the approved slot model.
- [ ] The booking is linked to the authenticated donor and confirmed in the interface.
- [ ] A booking that would exceed configured capacity is rejected.
- [ ] Concurrent booking attempts cannot exceed the approved capacity.
- [ ] Unavailable or invalid slots cannot be booked.
- [ ] Ownership and booking-rule checks apply to direct API requests as well as UI actions.
- [ ] Concurrency tests use the chosen real database with separate connections.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, booking/negative/ownership tests, real-database capacity-concurrency evidence and a booking demo.

title: BB-22: Donor receives an appointment reminder
body:
## User story
As a donor, I want an appointment reminder so that I remember my scheduled donation.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-020; SEC-005.

## Planning
- Owner: Scheduling/notification/reporting owner
- Sprint: 5 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: BB-21; approved late-booking policy, scheduling/timezone rules and mocked channels

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] For bookings made sufficiently in advance, the reminder is sent at least 24 hours before the appointment.
- [ ] Bookings made less than 24 hours before the appointment follow an explicitly approved late-booking policy.
- [ ] An immediate late-booking reminder is not counted as satisfying the 24-hour requirement.
- [ ] The reminder references the correct donor and approved appointment details without unnecessary health data.
- [ ] Durable notification intent, successful mocked receipt and retry/failure behavior are tested separately.
- [ ] Reminder timing uses approved timezone and clock-boundary rules.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, timing/late-booking/privacy tests, successful mocked receipt and durable retry/failure evidence.

title: BB-24: Administrator generates date-range activity reports
body:
## User story
As an administrator, I want reports of donations, issues and wastage over a selected date range so that I can review activity and losses.

## Classification
FR — Functional requirement

## Requirements
FR-023; SEC-002; SEC-003.

## Planning
- Owner: Scheduling/notification/reporting owner
- Sprint: 5; final validation in Sprint 6 — proposed; confirm before commitment
- Story points: TBD — re-estimate the revised scope
- Dependencies: Donation/issue/wastage records; BB-16; approved date-boundary/timezone and wastage definitions

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The administrator can select a valid date range and generate the required report.
- [ ] Donation, issue and wastage figures reconcile with approved source-record fixtures.
- [ ] Date boundaries and timezone treatment follow the approved reporting policy.
- [ ] Invalid or reversed date ranges are rejected with clear feedback.
- [ ] Empty ranges produce a valid empty report rather than misleading totals.
- [ ] Unauthorized users cannot generate or retrieve administrator-only reports.
- [ ] The donation-record source and wastage classifications are explicitly defined before acceptance.

## Evidence
Reviewed PR, report reconciliation/date-boundary/validation/access tests and a date-range reporting demo.
